description: Create a Grok Imagine task on RunAPI (text to video). Returns a task id, status, and output URLs.

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. Declared type: string. Known values: "2:3", "3:2", "1:1", "16:9", "9:16", "auto".

callback_url.description: Webhook URL for terminal Task delivery. Declared type: string.

duration_seconds.description: Output duration in seconds. Declared type: integer.

enable_safety_checker.description: Enable content safety checks. Declared type: boolean.

model.description: RunAPI model slug for this model line.

motion_style.description: Video motion style. Declared type: string.

output_resolution.description: Output resolution. Declared type: string. Known values: "480p", "720p", "1080p".

prompt.description: Video generation prompt. Declared type: string.

reference_image_urls.description: Not accepted by this model. Declared type: array.

wait.description: Poll until the task reaches a terminal status.

name: text_to_video
